expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: Row 3 says 'Search is a `<div onClick>`... no focus, no Enter/Space handling and no role', row 4 says the search control 'has no accessible name', and row 5 says 'The delete button has an icon only and no accessible name'.

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Row 8 says '`onPaste={(e) => e.preventDefault()}` blocks paste', and row 6 says 'Delete runs straight away with no confirmation'.

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Row 1 flags `height: '100vh'` and suggests `'100dvh'`, and row 2 says '`position: fixed; bottom: 0` ignores the safe area' and suggests `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
